proposal.reason: Primary scope is a new host one-sided RMA API family (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) and semantics that are not explicitly covered by a catalog module, so `other` is required. `enqueue` is needed for new RMA task creation/planning and launch-path integration; `copy-engine` for the in-node CE RMA put/wait execution path and signal synchronization; `gin` for cross-node RMA proxy transport, plugin/context wiring, and progress loop; `communicator` for new `numRmaCtx` config parsing/defaulting and host-RMA capability negotiation/reporting; and `profiler` for new RMA API event types and descriptors.
